file_purpose: Research and implementation mapping for University of Lancashire Medicine and Surgery MBBS A100 2027 entry.

implemented: Home and International applicant-group routing using existing ApplySmart groups
GCSE English Language and Mathematics grade 5/B
A-level AAA including Chemistry plus one further science subject
IB 36 with HL Chemistry and a second HL science at grade 6
representable graduate 2:1 route with GCSE and Home UCAT retained
Home UCAT 1750 ApplySmart working historical guidance threshold
official published Home/UK and International intake places as reference-only metadata
excluded: North West residency/Foundation Entry restriction by product-scope decision
definitive IELTS enforcement while official sources conflict

applicant_pool.notes: Home/UK applicants use the existing Home group; International applicants use the existing International group. Regional UK residency is intentionally not modelled.

limitations: Official UCAT cut-off is not published.
Academic scoring formula is not published.
Personal statement and reference weighting is not published.
Interview shortlisting threshold is not published.
North West residency/Foundation Entry restriction is intentionally not modelled.

metadata.intake_figures_notes: Official published intake numbers for Home/UK and International A100 places. These figures are informational only and do not affect eligibility, interview prediction, applicant ranking or the eligibility-only methodology.

a_level.standard: AAA including Chemistry plus one further science subject

ib.hl: Chemistry and another science subject at Higher Level grade 6.

graduate.degree: 2:1 Honours degree in Science/Health, or 2:1 in another subject plus BBB at A-level with two sciences including Chemistry.
graduate.automation_status: 2:1 classification, GCSE and Home UCAT are executable; degree subject and alternate BBB evidence remain documented boundaries.

english_language.discrepancy: UCAS states IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with no component below 7.0; the university course page states 7.0 in all components. ApplySmart does not enforce a definitive IELTS rule until resolved.

evidence_gaps.notes: Product decision: do not collect or evaluate regional UK residency or UCLan Foundation Entry status. Do not expose this as an applicant-facing failure or warning.
No official University of Lancashire UCAT cut-off is published.
UCAT is used for UK applicants, but weighting is not published.
Academic scoring is referenced but the formula is not published.
Personal reflective statement, academic reference and selection panel weighting is not published and cannot be objectively scored by ApplySmart.
No official SJT use policy was located.
Official UCAS and university IELTS wording conflicts.
